title: Lift the Rock
idea: A lever trades distance for force: a push further from the middle, or a load closer to it, lifts more.

serves.objective: Use a lever to lift a heavy load with a small force, and explain the trade between force and distance

lever.title: Lift the rock
lever.scene: <svg viewBox='0 0 320 110' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><polygon points='160,80 146,102 174,102' fill='#94a3b8'/><rect x='24' y='74' width='272' height='6' rx='3' fill='#b45309'/><g data-bind='rock_arm' data-move='-22,0'><circle cx='160' cy='60' r='14' fill='#64748b'/></g><g data-bind='push_arm' data-move='22,0'><text x='160' y='68' font-size='22' text-anchor='middle'>✋</text></g><g data-bind='lifts' data-show='yes'><text x='160' y='22' fill='#34d399' font-size='14' text-anchor='middle'>The rock lifts!</text></g><g data-bind='lifts' data-show='no'><text x='160' y='22' fill='#f87171' font-size='14' text-anchor='middle'>The rock stays down</text></g></svg>

draft.prompt: The rock weighs {{rock}}. Use the lever to lift it.

help.says: Each side turns the plank: how hard times how far from the middle. Make your side turn at least as much as the rock's side.

add_stimulus.text: Turning = how hard × how far from the middle

simplify.says: I set your push to 6. Now find where to push.

draft.why: The child finds that a small push can lift a heavier rock, and that how hard and how far both count.

draft.prompt: Your push is {{p_push}}. What is the closest spot to the middle where your push still lifts the rock?

help.says: Work out the rock's turning first: its weight times its distance from the middle.

simplify.says: One of these spots is out.

draft.why: The child predicts from the rule before running it: the least distance at which push times distance reaches the rock's turning.

draft.prompt: Test your answer. Your push stays at {{p_push}}. Make the rock lift.

help.says: Your turning has to be at least the rock's turning.

simplify.says: I moved your hand part of the way out.

draft.why: The child tests the prediction on the same lever and sees the result: with the push held, only distance can make up the difference.

draft.prompt: A heavier rock: it weighs {{rock2}}, and your push can only go up to {{push_max}}. Lift it.

help.says: Your side is as far out as it goes. Look at the rock's side of the plank.

add_stimulus.text: Rock's turning = rock weight × rock distance

simplify.says: I slid the rock right next to the middle and moved your hand out.

draft.why: Moving the load closer to the middle is the other half of the lever trade, and the only way left to lift this rock.
